comparison.purpose: Full framework objective by overall interaction policy; this is not an equal-visible-case ablation.
comparison.official: All four cells use the same 1024 clean Base Official Cases per round and seed block.
comparison.tail: Canonical Controller base.cvar is the mean of the largest ceil(0.20*N) per-Case errors.
comparison.upfront: 1024 fresh Cases generated once before each round and shared by both Agents; Base/Guided/Base-perturbed/Guided-perturbed each 256; no further draws.
comparison.adaptive: At most 1024 fresh team Cases per round, each Agent limited to 512 including its 16 Base + 16 Guided starter Cases and perturbed children.
comparison.guidance: Generated using the entering selected program (S0 in round 1); Guidance is frozen within each round.
comparison.costs: Report Agent elapsed time, total run elapsed time, Generator preparation/sampling and evaluator time separately; upfront preparation precedes the Agent clock.
